convertibility_reason: Uses no built-in indicators — all signals are derived from raw bar comparisons (Inside Bar, Black/White Insider, Bird patterns, and custom Zig_level calculations). While it uses standard MT5 Trade library .mqh files (Trade.mqh, SymbolInfo.mqh, DealInfo.mqh, PositionInfo.mqh), these are not custom indicator libraries. However, the entire signal logic is custom price-action pattern matching that has no built-in indicator equivalent and must be manually reimplemented in Python. Order management is simple (single position per symbol, market orders), so the difficulty is moderate.

derived_values.name: Insider
derived_values.formula: r[1].high <= r[2].high AND r[1].low >= r[2].low (bar[1] is inside bar[2])

derived_values.name: Insider2
derived_values.formula: r[2].high <= r[3].high AND r[2].low >= r[3].low (bar[2] is inside bar[3])

derived_values.name: Black_insider
derived_values.formula: Insider AND r[1].close <= r[1].open (bearish inside bar)

derived_values.name: White_insider
derived_values.formula: Insider AND r[1].close > r[1].open (bullish inside bar)

derived_values.name: White_bird
derived_values.formula: White_insider AND r[2].close > r[2].open (bullish inside bar after bullish outer bar)

derived_values.name: Black_bird
derived_values.formula: Black_insider AND r[2].close < r[2].open (bearish inside bar after bearish outer bar)

derived_values.name: Zig_level_buy
derived_values.formula: IF r[1] is bullish: r[1].close - (r[1].close - r[1].open) / 3; ELSE: r[1].close - (r[1].close - r[1].low) / 3

derived_values.name: Zig_level_sell
derived_values.formula: IF r[1] is bearish: r[1].close + (r[1].open - r[1].close) / 3; ELSE: r[1].close + (r[1].high - r[1].close) / 3

derived_values.name: Confirm_buy
derived_values.formula: (r[0].low <= Zig_level_buy OR hour >= 8) AND NOT Black_bird AND NOT White_insider

derived_values.name: Confirm_sell
derived_values.formula: (r[0].high >= Zig_level_sell OR hour >= 8) AND NOT White_bird AND NOT Black_insider

derived_values.name: Buy_signal
derived_values.formula: r[0].high > r[1].high (current bar breaks above prior bar high)

derived_values.name: Sell_signal
derived_values.formula: r[0].low < r[1].low (current bar breaks below prior bar low)

long.right: Confirm_buy AND r[0].low > r[1].low AND r[1].low < r[2].high

short.right: Confirm_sell AND r[0].high < r[1].high AND r[1].high > r[2].low

other_exits: Close long when Sell_signal AND Confirm_sell AND r[0].high < r[1].high (no requirement for r[1].high > r[2].low)
Close short when Buy_signal AND Confirm_buy AND r[0].low > r[1].low (no requirement for r[1].low < r[2].high)
Exit conditions are simpler than entry — entry adds an extra r[1] vs r[2] cross-check that exit does not require

params.comment: MaximumRisk parameter works with zero value — no risk-based sizing implemented

custom_logic_notes: This is a price-action breakout EA based on the Inside Bar (Insider) pattern. The core strategy: (1) Identify inside bars and their bullish/bearish character, (2) Compute Zig_level buy/sell thresholds as 1/3 retracement levels from the prior bar, (3) Enter long on upside breakout (current high > prior high) with confirmation that current low touched the Zig buy zone or hour>=8, excluding Black_bird and White_insider patterns, (4) Enter short on downside breakout symmetrically. The exit conditions mirror entry but with one fewer condition (no cross-bar check against bar[2]). The time filter is embedded in Confirm_buy/Confirm_sell: after hour 8, the Zig_level price test is bypassed (OR clause). The InvertSignals input swaps all buy/sell signals. Global variables prevent duplicate entries within the same bar (LBT/LST). StopLevel checks validate SL/TP distance from broker minimums.
backtest_data_needs: Any symbol with 5-digit pricing, H1 or lower, 730 days
python_conversion_notes: The signal logic is entirely custom price-action pattern matching on OHLC bars — no built-in indicators to map. Reimplement the 4-bar pattern detection (Insider, Black/White Insider, Bird patterns) and Zig_level calculation directly in Python using pandas bar comparisons. The entry/exit conditions are boolean combinations of these derived values — straightforward to code but must carefully replicate the bar indexing (r[0]=current, r[1]=prior, etc. with ArraySetAsSeries=true). The GlobalVariable guard (LBT/LST) maps to a simple 'last signal bar timestamp' tracker in Python. The time filter (hour >= 8 bypasses Zig_level check) is an OR condition within Confirm_buy/Confirm_sell. InvertSignals is a simple signal swap. SL/TP in points need Point value conversion. Position check (single position) maps to checking current holdings.
